name: b5984-door
prompt: Vertical 9:16 photoreal cinematic, close view of the doorway of a 7th-century mud-brick house in an Arabian oasis: a dark woven camel-hair curtain is drawn aside and tied back, revealing a warm sunlit interior. On a woven palm-fibre mat just inside the threshold sit a wooden bowl of dark dates and a plain earthenware water jug with two simple clay cups, set out for a visitor. Bright morning light falling across the threshold, rich warm colours, clean and inviting. No people, no hands, no text, no modern objects.
